notes.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate Brings Its Biggest Ever Update
notes.notes: [p][i][b]Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate[/b][/i] is powering up with its biggest update since launch! With both free and paid content, there is something for everyone. We are taking the game to the next level on [b]September 30, 2025[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="iXGD8H4X0KI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]So, without further ado, let’s walk through what you can expect:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/77c79a2ae2f12447cadb4aa167500ddd08fc5ee4.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER DLC – METALHEAD ENTERS THE FIGHT[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i][b]Metalhead[/b][/i] has created a device to investigate a mysterious realm, the portals, and their connection to the Turtles’ enemies. But something goes horribly wrong… a rift opens beneath NYC, directly under Rupert’s Pizza, to Mikey’s horror. The Turtle family, together with [i][b]Metalhead[/b][/i], must enter the realm to stop the chaos from consuming the city.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]As the [b]sixth hero[/b] on the Splintered Fate roster, [i][b]Metalhead[/b][/i] brings a brand-new playstyle and build strategies to master. He is our first [b]full-range hero[/b], armed with a [b]powerful laser gun[/b], [b]explosive landmines[/b] that will detonate on enemy contact, and [b]tactical skills[/b] to keep enemies at bay. The DLC also comes with 5 new artifacts to spice up your runs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/232b4b70dad768d92baaad77d0ae91c2262d4d53.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can wishlist the Metalhead DLC here! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784190/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Splintered_Fate__Metalhead/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]MAJOR TITLE UPDATE – FREE FOR ALL PLAYERS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]While the new [i][b]Metalhead[/b][/i] DLC will be available separately, we’re also releasing a [i][b]Major Title Update[/b][/i] that will be completely [b]FREE[/b] for all Splintered Fate players to download. Simply update your game on September 30 and jump right in to the new content![/p][p][/p][h3][b]NEW ARCADE MODE – HEX AND FLEX YOUR WAY TO THE RIFT (Free)[/b][/h3][p align="start"]A brand-new game mode has arrived. [i][b]Arcade Mode[/b][/i] is intense, fast-paced, and unpredictable. It offers unique challenge runs to push you and your friends’ skills to the limit.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/0c460730029074e6831981d9c5dbb91fd48251b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Central to this mode is the new [i][b]Hex and Flex[/b][/i] system. At each level break, choose one of three [i][b]Hex and Flex[/b][/i] combos. These combos can both empower you with strong advantages (Flex) and weaken you with serious drawbacks (Hex). Strategy is key, as every run becomes an unpredictable adventure.[/p][p align="start"]Highlights include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hex and Flex[/b] system offering major variety (and plenty of chaos) to each run[/p][/*][*][p]A fast-paced and [b]accessible mode[/b], perfect for quick sessions solo or with friends[/p][/*][*][p][b]Three new biomes[/b] that twist reality inside out: the Spectral Sewers, Astral Ship, and Manic Metropolis[/p][/*][*][p]An all-new [b]Wraith enemy[/b] set with multiple variants: multi-limbed beings that fire homing projectiles and teleport for added chaos[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Invasion:[/b] The realm reshapes battles in unexpected ways, creating unpredictable enemy combinations[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Available for free for all players, find [i][b]Arcade Mode[/b][/i] through the new Home Lair portal to [i][b]Metalhead’[/b][/i]s Lab and jump into the action! We will be adding more content to the mode soon, stay tuned for more![/p][p][/p][h3][b]METALHEAD COMPANION CONTENT (Free)[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i][b]Metalhead[/b][/i]’s debut ties directly into this new free mode, bringing additional content for all players. Players will be able to enjoy this mode even if they haven’t bought the [i][b]Metalhead[/b][/i] DLC.[/p][list][*][p][b]Robotics Turtle Power tree[/b] leveraging “charge effects” for high-impact actions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drone tools [/b]that add devastating passive and active ranged support[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pizza in Peril[/b] storyline, a new narrative arc connected to Arcade Mode[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Artifact – Positronic Motherboard[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]GAME IMPROVEMENTS (Free)[/b][/h3][p align="start"]AND THERE’S MORE!!! We’ve also added over 100 improvements across the game. Expect visual polish, balancing adjustments, bug fixes, and quality-of-life updates throughout.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/92d7ec1c84e637b3c0c0cc32f705be78bc331e34.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/8162e7679d1fb05571552aa8516f3e34c7717615.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]LAUNCH DETAILS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]All new content arrives [b]September 30, 2025 [/b]for all digital & physical platforms, alongside the launch of our first physical editions; the [i][b]Deluxe Edition[/b][/i] will be available for Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X, and Xbox One. The [i][b]Pipin’ Hot Collector’s Edition[/b][/i] will follow on [b]October 24, 2025[/b]. Please check your favorite retailer for more info.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]📅 SEPTEMBER 30, 2025[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This will be our biggest moment since the release of Splintered Fate, and we couldn’t be more excited. Whether you’re a new player or a long-time fan, this update has something for you. We hope you’ll join us in celebrating our biggest update ever![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]As always, you can connect with fellow Splintered Fate fans, ask questions, or share suggestions in the [url="https://discord.gg/superevilmc"][u]Super Evil Megacorp Discord[/u][/url] or on our social channels: [url="https://www.instagram.com/superevilmegacorp"][u]Instagram[/u][/url] | [url="https://www.facebook.com/SuperEvilMegacorp/"][u]Facebook[/u][/url] | [url="https://twitter.com/superevilmegaco"][u]X[/u][/url] | [url="https://www.youtube.com/@Super-Evil-Megacorp"][u]YouTube[/u][/url] | [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@super.evil.megacorp"][u]TikTok[/u][/url] | [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/super-evil-megacorp/"][u]LinkedIn[/u][/url].[/p]

notes.title: Update - PlayStation Platforms Added and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
COWBUNGA Turtles Fans! We’re totally stoked to report that as of tomorrow we’re welcoming new players on the PlayStation platform with our digital launch on PS5 and PS4. This means new Turtle friends for online match-making. 

We’ll continue to support crossplay by adding in the PlayStation platform as well as a couple of minor bug fixes to keep things running smoothly. 

If you have any questions or suggestions please drop us a comment or join the [url=https://discord.gg/superevilmc]Super Evil Megacorp Discord[/url]. And until then, raise some shell and enjoy having even more Splintered Fate players join the co-op pizza party.

notes.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate (PS5) Review
notes.notes:
Much like the inevitability of certain movie franchises getting reboot regularly, it seemed a matter of time until Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate would eventually continue its journey from Apple Arcade to Nintendo Switch to Sony and Microsoft’s shores. Unlike some of those movie revivals, however, this game is undoubtedly worth checking out.

If you haven’t already checked it out on the other platforms, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate is a roguelike take on the ultimate 90s franchise. With 1-4 players, the Turtles must navigate four stages, building skills and modifiers while mopping the floor with Foot Clan ninjas, mouse robots, and other familiar groups of foes in order to rescue their father and sensei, Splinter, from an ethereal captor.

In typical fashion, each of the brothers has their own distinctive playstyle based on their weapons of choice—starting with a basic combo, a special attack, and a “tool” suited to their... Read more

notes.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate joins the Midweek Deal, Plus NEW Steam Community Items
notes.notes:
Shellheads, we’re closing out March in a big way with not one but two exciting updates for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate!

First, in case you missed it, we recently dropped our biggest patch yet, bringing major balance improvements and power tweaks to make your runs even more fun. This update was shaped by your feedback, and we can’t thank you enough for your support! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2996040/view/511827488716882143?l=english]Check out the full patch notes here.[/url]

Now, for the news you’ve been waiting for: If you've been thinking about jumping into Splintered Fate or convincing a friend to join you in co-op- now’s the perfect time! [b]The game is currently 50% off during Steam’s Midweek Deal, running until April 14th.[/b] This is our biggest discount ever, so don’t miss out on the chance to grab it (or gift it) at an awesome price!

[previewyoutube=eYDBa6dWELY;full][/previewyoutube]

And for those already battling against the Foot Clan on Steam, we’ve got another surprise: Steam Community Items are here! You can now earn trading cards, profile backgrounds, badges, and emoticons just by playing the game. If you've been with us from the start, don’t worry, your playtime counts! You’ll automatically receive a set of items based on how many hours you’ve logged. 

Want to connect with other Splintered Fate fans, share feedback, or just talk turtles? Join our Discord or follow Super Evil Megacorp on social media, we’d love to hear from you! 

The SEMC team

notes.title: Balance of Power Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Cowabunga, Fellow Shellheads!

First off, a huge thank you for all your support, feedback, and turtle-powered enthusiasm over the past few months! We've been keeping a close eye on your thoughts across Discord, social media, and forums, and we’re stoked to introduce our biggest player-focused update of the year. 

This Community Update brings boss and power balancing tweaks to make fights more fun and fair, along with key bug fixes and progression improvements to keep your runs feeling rewarding. Our goal is to make TMNT: Splintered Fate the best version it can be.

And we’re just getting started, there’s more exciting stuff coming in 2025, so stay tuned! Please let us know your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.gg/superevilmc]Super Evil Megacorp Discord channel[/url]. For the latest updates, be sure to follow us on all major social media platforms, including Bluesky, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and Twitter.

[h2]Boss Updates[/h2]
We have rebalanced the various bosses to better reflect the position they appear in the campaign. Karai was a bit more ruthless than her grandfather Shredder, so both have been adjusted to be easier and more challenging, respectively. Leatherhead also received adjustments to his Amphibian Ambush encounter whilst Gigi from our Junkyard Jam DLC has received a slight adjustment to make her a little more fair.

[h3]Karai[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved warning on the first Dash, adding 0.3s to it
[*] Previously it was 0.4s, now 0.7s
[*] Reduced her period of invulnerability after performing her Rage attack
[*] This is the one she uses after her rage bar is full (round kunai explosion where she yells)
[*] Previously, she was invulnerable for the full duration of the animation
[*] Now she becomes vulnerable right after the kunai come out, providing a great opportunity to counter attack
[/list]

[h3]Super Shadow (Hard Mode)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shadow Flames should be slightly easier to dodge;
[*] Reduced Movement Speed by 20%
[*] Reduced Rotation Speed
[*] Fire Bomb radius decreased to be slightly lower than Mystic Karai’s version rather than of slightly bigger
[*] Adds now spawn separately, first at 75% and then 50% of Karai's HP
[/list]

[h3]Mystic Karai (Flame variant)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Decreased size of Mystic Karai's Flames by ~30%
[/list]

[h3]Leatherhead (Punk Frog version)[/h3]

Reviewed all Punk Frog spawns in order to:
[list]
[*] Avoid exaggerated overlapping
[*] Reduce their total numbers (you should expect to see 50% less Punk Frogs overall)
[/list]

[h3]Gigi[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gigi’s chop and 360 spin attack now has a bigger windup
[*] This is to make it more reactable to players, right now it's too fast
[*] Increase was +0.55s (from 0.45s to 1.0s)
[/list]

[h3]Shredder[/h3]
Reviewed all adds, which now follow the following logic

At the start of battle, Shredder gets help from basic Footclan enemies for the first ~20 seconds
[list]
[*] No elites, just Sword, Shuriken and Spear Foot Soldiers 
[/list]

Once he transitions to the second phase, different Foot Soldiers will spawn depending on which Elemental variant Shredder transitions to
[list]
[*] Astral summons a mix of Flame and Shadow Ninjas
[*] Fire summons all Flame Ninjas
[*] Ninja summons a mix of Shuriken Ninjas
[*] Water summons Spear Ninjas
[*] Utrom summons Swordbrakers
[*] Ooze summons all Shadow Ninjas
[/list]

Shredder's Leap during Phase 3 has also been modified

Now instead of always leaping twice, he'll do a first leap and then 1 out of 4 possible follow up options
[list]
[*] Another Leap (as it was previously)
[*] Shadow Fracture (shadow flames on the ground)
[*] Shadow Pursuit (gets on the ground and moves while intangible)
[*] Shadow Kick (flying kick)
[/list]

[h2]Dragon and Dreamer Coin Economy Improvements[/h2]

Across the board, we have significantly reduced the cost of Dragon and Dreamer coin upgrades. We feel that the overall costs were much too high, and they have been changed to better reflect the progression experience throughout the campaign. 

You will see a reduction of costs in low to mid rank upgrades, and a pretty major reduction to costs to many of the high rank upgrades. In addition, we have also adjusted the position and amount of special currencies (Shredder’s Claw, Gauntlet Coins, etc) required at different upgrade ranks.

[h2]Dragon Coin Upgrades[/h2]

[h3]Training[/h3]

Health
[list]
[*] Significant decrease in cost per rank
[/list]

Dash Charge
[list]
[*] A slight increase to early Dash Charge upgrade costs
[*] Significant reduction in the cost of the final cost of the last Dash charge upgrades.
[/list]

Splinter's Revive
[list]
[*] A slight increase to early Splinter's Revive upgrade costs, 
[*] Significant reduction in the cost of the final cost of the last Dash charge upgrades.
[/list]

Swiftness
[list]
[*] A decrease in overall cost to upgrade Swiftness.
[/list]

Savor The Flavor
[list]
[*] Decrease in cost per rank.
[/list]

Slice of Life
[list]
[*] A slight decrease in % chance to drop pizza gained per rank. 
[*] Decrease in cost per rank.
[/list]

Astral Rejuvenation
[list]
[*] A decrease in overall cost to upgrade.
[/list]

[h3]Technique[/h3]

Attack Damage
[list]
[*] Significant decrease in cost per rank.
[/list]

Critical Chance
[list]
[*] Very slight increase in overall cost to upgrade. Critical strike is very powerful!
[/list]

Focused Forces

[*] Reduced overall cost at higher ranks.
[/list]

Special Damage

[/list]

[h3]Economy[/h3]

Running Start

[*] Slight decrease in cost at higher ranks.
[/list]

Scrappy Bosses

[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[h3]Exotic[/h3]

Mouse Scrap

[/list]

Fortune Favours The Bold

[/list]

Busted Coin Slot

Dojo
[list]
[*] Significant decrease in cost at all ranks.
[/list]

[h2]Artifact Upgrade Costs[/h2]

We felt that Artifact upgrade costs were also prohibitively expensive, leading to players typically focusing on upgrading one or two Artifacts. We want to encourage more build experimentation by making upgrading additional Artifacts a more achievable goal. In addition, some of the meta currency requirements (Shredder’s Claw, Gauntlet Coin, etc) have been adjusted in the costs.

Artifacts with 5 additional levels have had costs reduced as follows
[list]
[*] Level 2: Was 250 reduced to 150
[*] Level 3: Was 400 reduced to 200
[*] Level 4: Was 700 reduced to 300
[*] Level 5: Was 1000 reduced to 400
[*] Level 6: Was 1500 reduced to 600
[/list]

Artifacts with 2 additional levels have had costs reduced as follows
[list]
[*] Level 2: Was 500 reduced to 300
[*] Level 3: Was 1000 reduced to 600
[/list]
*Note, Artifacts are unlocked at level 1 via gameplay

[h2]Powers and Tools[/h2]

We are aware of the power of builds such as Critical Strike, Shurikens and Ooze, and instead of focusing on nerfs, we have decided to adjust all the other power trees to perform better! We want players to feel like they have more freedom in pursuing build options that are totally radical, rather than feel like they need to play the same few builds to tackle the hardest content. 

In turn, this will also make the experience of the many runs you make much smoother, as there is a much better chance of putting a winning build together. We hope players can discover new and exciting build combinations to try out!

[h3]Tools[/h3]

We want some of the weaker tool options to feel more viable, so we’re making a number of improvements here.

Utrom Shurikens
[list]
[*] Now releases 4 shuriken, up from 2.
[*] Fixed a problem with a delay issue between the releases of Shuriken.
[/list]

Lightning Rod
[list]
[*] Lightning Rod will now behave more consistently, and strike more targets, making it more powerful.
[*] Resolved an issue that was causing Lightning Rod to repeatedly strike targets, even if they are dead.
[*] Improved charged strikes to 6/8/10, up from 3/4/5
[/list]

Ooze Shuriken
[list]
[*] Now releases 4 shuriken, up from 2.
[*] Fixed a problem with a delay issue between the releases of Shuriken.
[/list]

Smoke Bomb
[list]
[*] We have adjusted Smoke Bomb to improve the feeling of control when you teleport, improved its damage, and instead of a Dodge trigger, we have granted it a Dodge Chance buff. Ninja Vanish!
[*] Teleport distance reduced by 40%
[*] Damage increased to 50/60/70 from 30/50/70. 
[*] Removed Dodge Effects trigger. 
[*] Added a 15/25/35% chance to Dodge for 5 seconds upon using Smoke Bomb.
[/list]

Meteor Storm
[list]
[*] Meteor is an undeniably powerful tool, and while we want it to remain that way, we're adjusting its damage and its rate of releasing meteors. Meteors will drop slowly enough to no longer overlap each other, and should feel a big weightier. We also fixed an issue with timing that caused one less meteor to drop each time you used the tool.
[*] Meteor's damage has been adjusted to 20/40/60 from 40/60/80. 
[*] Meteor Storm now releases meteors less frequently, up to 1.0s from every 0.5s. 
[*] Number of meteors adjusted to 6/8/10 from 9/12/15
[/list]

Fireball
[list]
[*] We've improved Fireball to release four fireballs, up from three, and its damage has been adjusted. In addition, it now impacts a larger area, making it both more consistent and more powerfull.
[*] Fireball now releases 4 projectiles at all ranks, up from 3. 
[*] Fireball impact has been doubled. 
[*] Damage of each fireball adjusted to 30/50/70 from 40/70/100 to reflect having an additional fireballl.
[/list]

Water Sweep
[list]
[*] Water Sweep should now feel more consistent with a fixed range at all ranks. It now deals more damage, and stuns enemies instead of knocking them back. All of these changes make Water Sweep more powerful.
[*] Damage has been increased to 80/100/120 from 60/80/120.
[*] Radius set to 4m at all ranks. 
[*] Now stuns for 1.0s instead of knocks back.
[/list]

[h3]Utrom[/h3]
The Utrom tree has a unique mechanic, the charge bar, that we felt was not quite living up to its potential. So, we’ve made major improvements to it! In addition, we’ve made lightning strike abilities more consistent and frequent across the board. We think you’ll be in for a shocking good time.

Lighting Strike
[list]
[*] Lightning strike now deals more damage at early ranks.
[*] Damage increased to 20/25/30 from 10/20/30.
[/list]

Lightning Dash
[list]
[*] We want Dash builds to be slightly more viable, so we've increased the number of targets hit while also increasing its damage at lower ranks. Lightning Dash now also targets a larger area.
[*] Number of targets hit is now 3/4/5.
[*] Damage increased to 20/25/30.
[*] Targets a larger area.
[/list]

Quick Study
[list]
[*] We have adjusted Quick Study's charge rate, to account for the power changes we have provided to Utrom across the board.
[*] Charge rate adjusted to 50/100/150% from 75/125/200%
[/list]

Shocking
[list]
[*] We have increased the base charge of the Utrom charge bar. Unlimited Power!
[*] Increased charge rate by 20%
[/list]

Electrifying
[list]
[*] We have adjusted the scaling on Electrify to be more powerful at lower ranks.
[*] Damage adjusted to 10/15/20 from 7/15/22
[/list]

Chain Lightning
[list]
[*] Chain Lightning can now target a much larger area, making it more consistent and more powerful. We have adjusted the scaling to be slightly better at lower ranks.
[*] Radius set increased by 60%.
[*] Damage scaling set to 10/15/20 from 7/15/21
[/list]

Stormy Weather
[list]
[*] We have improved Stormy Weather's consistency by increasing its range and adjusting the scaling of damage.
[*] Radius increased by 20%
[*] Damage scaling set to 10/15/20 from 7/14/21.
[/list]

Techno-Organic Interface
[list]
[*] We are lightly adjusting movement speed to be a bit more in control. Crafty turtles will still go fast!
[*] Movement speed granted is set to 15% at all ranks.
[/list]

Biomechanical Speed
[list]
[*] We wanted to grant a higher window of opportunity to use the benefit of Biomechanical Speed
[*] Duration increased to 3/4/5s
[/list]

Aftershock
[list]
[*] We are also making Aftershock more consistent with a higher range.
[*] Radius increased by 60%
[/list]

[h3]Ooze[/h3]
Our goopiest power tree is also one of our most powerful. We have left it largely unchanged. Slime on!

Shelf Life
[list]
[*] We want Shelf Life to feel like it leaves a lasting impression when you choose it, so we're increasing how long the bonuses last.
[*] Improved number of rooms Shelf Life is active to 4/5/6
[/list]

[h3]Flame[/h3]
Flame tree is in a really good place, but we wanted to see if we could make an Inferno build a bit more viable.

Flame Strike
[list]
[*] Flame Strike will deal slightly more damage.
[*] Damage increased to 25/35/45 from 20/30/40.
[/list]

Inferno
[list]
[*] We want to make Inferno more threatening, so we are making it deal more damage by letting it deal damage more frequently.
[*] Inferno deals its damage more frequently, up from every 0.5s to every 0.3s
[/list]

Blazing Inferno
[list]
[*] An increase to Blazing Inferno's duration along with the improvement to Inferno will make this fire DoT more threatening.
[*] Blazing Inferno now increases the duration of Inferno to 3/4/5 seconds from 2/3/4 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]Water[/h3]
In a previous update, we added an entirely new build alternative with Still Waters (and friends). We still think Water can have more potential to create new builds, so we’re improving many of the powers across the board. Dive into these changes!

Torrential Strike
[list]
[*] We are pushing up Multi-Strike in a few ways, including how much is provided by Torrential Strike.
[*] Torrential Strike now increases Multi-Hit chance by 8/10/12% up from 5/7/10%.
[/list]

Water Dash
[list]
[*] Water Dash will feel more consistent with a higher range, and we have also increased its damage. Let's go, Dash builds!
[*] Water Dash range increased by 60% at all ranks.
[*] Damage has been increased to 45/60/75 from 35/45/60.
[/list]

Water Abilities
[list]
[*] Water Abilities could be a little more powerful, so we're improving its damage.
[*] Water Abilities now deals 55/70/85 damage, from 45/60/75.
[/list]

Splash Damage
[list]
[*] Cleave damage builds can be really fun, so we want Splash Damage to feel more viable.
[*] Damage to nearby enemies increased to 40/55/70% of water damage, from 30/45/60%.
[/list]

When it Rains
[list]
[*] We have improved the damage provided by When It Rains, which will further be improved by other changes to Multi-Hit.
[*] Damage increased to 30/45/60, from 24/38/52
[/list]

Frost
[list]
[*] Frost should feel more like you are overwhelming your enemies with relentless cold. We have significantly increased its slow, and now the slow also lasts longer.
[*] Frost now slows enemies further by 50/60/70  from 20/35/50. 
[*] Duration increased to 2.5s.
[/list]

[h3]Ninja[/h3]
Ninja is one of our better performing power trees, so it remains mostly unchanged.

Extended Assault
[list]
[*] Extended Assault felt too powerful with no investment in the Ninja power tree. We've added three requirements before it will be unlocked. (Any Shuriken ability/tool, Either Ricochet or Chakram, Either Quick Feet or First Strike to unlock it.)
[/list]
First Strike
[list]
[*] We wanted to make First Strike part of more Ninja builds. There are now no requirements to unlock First Strike, and First Strike will help with unlocking numerous Ninja Powers.
[/list]

Art of Darkness
[list]
[*] We're making Art of Darkness provide a little bit more elemental power.
[*] Damage scaling increased to 15/20/25 from 10/15/20. 
[/list]

[h3]Astral Light[/h3]
In a future patch, we’re thrilled to say that we’re going to be providing massive overhauls to the Astral Light power tree. Until then, we’re making a number of changes to improve this power tree to hold you over; there’s light at the end of THIS tunnel.


Daybreak
[list]
[*] We have improved Daybreak's scaling Damage Reduction on Blinding Light, to be a more powerful defensive tool if you invest in it.
[*] Damage reduction per rank now set to 4/6/8%, changed from flat 5% per rank.
[/list]

Shimmering Shield
[list]
[*] We want Light Shell to feel more consistent and provide more defense, so we're improving the duration of Light Shell granted by Shimmering Shield.
[*] Light shell duration increased to 1.5/2.5/3.5s from 1.2/1.8/2.3s
[/list]

Radiant Warrior
[list]
[*] Same as Shimmering Shield above, we want Light Shell to feel more consistent and provide more defense, so we're improving the duration of Light Shell granted by Radiant Warrior as well.
[*] Light shell duration increased to 1.5/2.5/3.5s from 1.2/1.8/2.3s
[/list]

Ancestral Guardian
[list]
[*] We've changed Ancestral Guardian to instead provide a significant boost to Elemental Damage. We hope the changes provided to Light Shell's duration elsewhere make this a consistent power for using in elemental builds.
[*] Removed Light Shell at the start of combat.
[*] Now grants 20/30/40% increased Elemental damage while Light Shell is active, instead of providing Light Shell for a duration at the start of a room.
[/list]

Illumination
[list]
[*] Illumination could use a little more shine, so we've increased the Light Damage from reflected projectiles.
[*] Damage increased to 45/60/75% of your Max Health, from 30/45/60%.
[/list]

Revved Up
[list]
[*] We've improved Revved Up's dodge chance provided on targets affected by Blinding Light. Combined with the changes to Daybreak, this will make Blinding Light a powerful defensive option.
[*] Dodge chance increased to 20/25/30%, from 10/15/20%
[/list]

[h3]Astral Dark[/h3]

Gift of the Dragon
[list]
[*] We wanted to give this power a bit more value. We also fixed the interaction with Dragon’s Claw to allow it to work.
[*] Increased Dragon Coins granted to 120.
[*] The Coins earned now correctly work with Dragon's Claw.
[/list]

Dark Star
[list]
[*] We've improved the damage provided by Dark Star. In addition, we have added a heal for every consumed Splinter's Revive, making the tradeoff of losing your Revives a more meaningful choice.
[*] Now grants 20% base damage, and +40% damage per rank. 
[*] Added a 15% heal per Splinter's Revive consumed.
[/list]

Dragon's Claw
[list]
[*] Dragon's Claw grants more damage when you receive Dragon Coins.
[*] Damage increased to 15/20/25%, from 10/15/20%. 
[/list]

[h3]Legendary Powers[/h3]

Finisher (Astral Dark/Ninja)
[list]
[*] Finisher had a very niche requirement in order to defeat enemies, so we decided to remove it to make it more viable for more builds. As a result, we've adjusted the threshold at which it will instantly defeat an enemy to compensate for its increased usefulness.
[*] Finisher no longer requires Guard Break to instantly defeat enemies.
[*] Instant defeat threshold is now 15%.
[/list]

Slippery (Ninja/Ooze)
[list]
[*] Adrenaline has been changed to be a more potent attack power, while adjusting how much mobility it provides.
[*] Removed Dash cooldown bonus.
[*] Decreased movespeed to 20%.
[*] Increased cooldown reduction to 100% for Special and Tools.
[/list]

Shatter (Frost/Utrom)
[list]
[*] Now requires at least 1 Utrom Power as was intended
[/list]

[h1]Control Updates[/h1]

We have updated the way targeting is handled across all control schemes to take directionality into consideration. The most obvious impact is that for players using a mouse, the cursor placement is now where you will attack. For players using a controller, the joystick direction will impact your attack target.

We have added a new setting in the Options menu for players to fine-tune how they would like to play. The “Aim Assist” settings are as follows:

Low
[list]
[*] Most precise. 
[*] Attack exactly where the player intends (mouse cursor position or their last inputted movement direction).
[/list]

Medium
[list]
[*] Look at where the player intends to attack, then SNAP to valid targets.
[*] Default behaviour for controllers and mouse and keyboard inputs.
[/list]

High
[list]
[*] Old behavior. Always snap to valid targets within range, even if it means spinning the player around 180 degrees.
[*] Default behaviour for touch screen inputs.
[/list]

[h1]Minor Updates & Bug Fixes[/h1]

[h2]Base Game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Artifacts that guarantee the next power type now correctly function when equipping them mid-run
[*] Fixed Gauntlet Medallions not being granted from first Sewers mini boss.
[*] “Reliable Allies” Dragon Upgrade now gives a greater chance of elite ally spawns the more it is upgraded, making the “Super Support” achievement more within your control to obtain.
[*] Ally MOUSERs and Super Soldiers now have an ally skin and footprint to help differentiate them from enemy MOUSERs and Super Soldiers.
[*] Darkest Soul and Perfection Achievements are now granted correctly again. We are sorry if you had issues with these achievements recently.
[/list]

[h2]Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam DLC[/h2]
[list]
[*] Victories against Gigi will now update correctly in the Stats screen.
[*] Casey’s Inspiration 2 Critical Hit chance will now execute properly based on the listed % in the upgrade description.
[*] “Defeat the Junkinator” achievement is now available for Apple players.
[*] Vintage Blowtorch artifact will now correctly stun targets hit simultaneously.
[/list]

notes.title: Casey Jones & The Junkyard Jam DLC OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Cowabunga, Shellheads! We’re stoked to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316670/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Splintered_Fate__Casey_Jones__the_Junkyard_Jam/]the first-ever DLC for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate featuring the one and only Casey Jones is now live[/url] on all current platforms, including Steam, Steam Deck, Epic Games Store and Nintendo Switch!

And for those of you waiting on other platforms, fear not! We’re hard at work to bring the game to even more platforms, stay tuned for upcoming updates. We’re always listening to your feedback and are incredibly grateful for your enthusiasm and patience.

[b]Casey Jones Joins the Fight[/b]

It’s time to grab your hockey stick and mask, because Casey Jones has officially entered the streets! This DLC introduces Casey as a playable character; with his unique hockey arsenal, Casey becomes the first character with a ranged attack. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting your journey, Casey’s unique playstyle will certainly energize your co-op sessions.

[previewyoutube=Qniex62DFSg;full][/previewyoutube]

The DLC also includes new challenges, unlockables, new story and a few surprises we can’t wait for you to discover. Perfect for group gaming sessions either online or in couch co-op, it’s an ideal opportunity for parents, kids, friends, couples and everyone in between to bond over some heroes in a half shell mayhem.

[b]Welcome to the Junkyard![/b]

Also coming in the DLC is an entirely new biome! The Junkyard becomes an alternate option to travelling to the Streets, providing its own unique encounters, challenges, bosses, and rewards. Casey Jones comes to the Turtles claiming he has found a shortcut to finding Shredder, leading the Turtles into a caper involving Punk Frogs, rock bands, toad mechanics, and more! The choice between the Junkyard and the Streets should be a matter of preference of what type of challenges you wish to overcome, and will provide new rewards and artifacts to equip. Get your junk on!

[b]Free Updates Are on the Horizon[/b]

The fun doesn’t stop here! We’re cooking up some amazing free updates. We've had plenty of time to observe and collect player feedback, and we'll be performing a significant balance pass over the entire game, from powers, to progression, and enemies and bosses. We'll be making adjustments to powers we believe under perform, certain boss encounters that we believe can be improved for a better overall experience, and we want to make the player progression feel quite less grindy. In the future, we’ll be bringing features like leaderboards and additional challenges to Teenage Mutant Turtles: Splintered Fate to create even more ways to play. Stay tuned as we unveil more details soon, your feedback continues to shape the game’s evolution. For the latest news and to get involved in the conversation join us on Discord and your favorite social media channels.

[b]From Our Team to You[/b]

This DLC marks the beginning of a new chapter for TMNT: Splintered Fate. We’ve poured our hearts and souls into crafting an experience that honors the TMNT legacy while keeping the gameplay fresh and fun.

Thank you for your unwavering support and passion. It means the world to us, and we hope this is just the start of a Turtle-tastic journey we can take together.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your crew, dive into the Casey Jones DLC, and show the Punk Frogs who’s boss.

Join us on Discord and share your thoughts -we can’t wait to hear what you think.

Cowabunga!
Daniel

notes.title: Casey Jones & The Junkyard Jam DLC Announced, Coming Out On FEB 5TH
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that Casey Jones will join Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate as a playable character on February 5th! But that’s not all—The Junkyard Jam also introduces a new playable area, powers, enemies, and bosses! Visit the Steam page and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316670/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Splintered_Fate__Casey_Jones__the_Junkyard_Jam/]wishlist the DLC here.[/url]

[previewyoutube=RQz4GcCDGqA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]CASEY JONES, OFF THE BENCH![/b]

The Turtles can use all the help they can get as they go up against Shredder and try to get their Father back. Thankfully, their friend and fellow vigilante Casey Jones is always ready to pick up his hockey stick and do some damage. What's more, he happens to know a shortcut to the rooftops of NYC! Strangely, their path takes them straight through the Junkyards and Punk Frog turf. Could this have anything to do with Casey’s missing ride?

They are no match for Casey, though– what he lacks in finesse he more than makes up for in raw power. His Slapshot Special Attack is the first ranged attack in the game, taking down punks from afar.

[b]WELCOME TO THE JUNKYARD[/b]

After defeating Karai, you will be given a choice to enter the Streets, or try your luck in the Junkyard. The Junkyard brings an all new narrative starring Casey, the Punk Frogs, their mechanic, Gigi, and a special encore surprise for the Turtles.

While a junkyard wouldn’t normally feel like home, the Punk Frogs have settled in and made it their own. The warmth from the blazing barrel fires, the completely non-toxic pools of water, the artistry of Frog graffiti peppering the landscape. What could be better?

Make sure you visit Gigi’s Chop Shop, the Crane Vista, and complete your stay with a lively bop in the Battlebot Arena.

[b]NEW ENEMIES AND CHALLENGING BOSSES[/b]

The Punk Frogs continue to test your patience while you make your way through the Junkyard. Attila, leader of the Punk Frogs, has cobbled together repurposed versions of Stockgen robots to wreak all kinds of havoc. Gigi, the vivacious toad mechanic and a threat the Turtles and their friends have never before faced, wields her sawblade with ferocity to make for a challenging mid-run foe. Your ultimate Junkyard challenge will be Genghis’ mech bot, The Junkinator, constructed from parts found both in the Junkyard and elsewhere, and perhaps even some parts familiar to the Turtles family...

[b]NEW WAYS TO PLAY[/b]

Earn 5 new Artifacts and explore using Casey’s inspirations, masteries, and tools across your runs with other characters! Artifacts include some helpful additions for co-operative group play, as well as new ways to control the battlefield. Casey’s suite of powers help him excel with his Special ability, Guard Break, and many more surprises.


[b]CO-OP MADNESS[/b]

Your friends don’t own Casey Jones & the Junkyard yet? No problem. Everyone can play the Junkyard in Online Play when the match host has access to it, or you can invite your friends over for a good old-fashioned game night couch co-op. Get your friends and family excited to share in the experience of Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam! 

The Junkyard Jam will be available on Steam, Steam Deck, Epic Store, Nintendo Switch, and Apple Arcade on February 5th. See you soon!

notes.title: That Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles roguelike I refuse to stop going on about is adding Casey Jones as a playable character and a junkyard full of frogs to goongala your way through

notes.title: PC Patch Notes v1.6.3 - Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Shellheads! 

Thank you for all the support you’ve shown us during the launch of this bodacious game on Steam and Epic Games Store. We have been listening to all the feedback that you’ve taken the time to give us. With that in mind, today, we’re excited to release the first of many updates to start addressing some of the issues you shared with us.


[list]
[*]Keyboard and mouse can now be used in Couch Co-op in conjunction with the gamepad. We hope that this will enable more of you to enjoy this game with friends and family. Just press enter on the keyboard to ready up on the player ready screen.[/list]
[list]
[*]To prevent accidental power selection, there is now a slight delay between the reward screen appearing and being able to select a reward. This should prevent players from dashing when the selection screen appears and accidentally getting the first reward in the list. [/list]
[list]
[*]A new accessibility option to disable “hold to dash” will help players who find themselves double-dashing when they only intended a single dash. By default, this option will remain enabled (matching the current in-game behavior), but you will be able to disable it to prevent holding the button to continually dash.[/list]
[list]
[*]We have fixed several online matchmaking issues, these should result in a smoother experience leaving and rejoining matches as well as ensuring you are connected to the most optimal gameserver for reduced ping.[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed a number of issues when using a PlayStation controller.[/list]
[list]
[*]We’ve also improved the range of controllers supported, including the Nimbus+ and generic gamepads, both with and without Steam Input enabled.[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed input latency issues for some devices, including players using keyboards set to Simplified Chinese language.[/list]
[list]
[*]We’ve addressed a heap of UI issues causing text to break onto new lines mid word or overlap with over UI.[/list]

We hope that everyone has a radical holiday season! The team has worked incredibly hard to get this update ready before they take a well earned rest to recharge ready to face-off the new year. We’ve got some big news to reveal in January, so watch this space! 

Did you know that you can change the difficulty of the game at any time in the pause menu? If you’re struggling a little, try lowering the difficulty until you’ve managed to buy some upgrades and then switch it back.

notes.title: TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA TURTLES: SPLINTERED FATE - OUT ON PC NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Shellheads! Today is a momentous day for us here at Super Evil Megacorp as Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate is finally live on PC, available now via Steam – with full Steam Deck compatibility – and Epic Games Store. We’re a humble team with big ambitions and this has been a huge learning experience for us. We are so grateful to everyone that’s come on this journey with us and we’re looking forward to continuing to push forward!

[previewyoutube=746ZDlFZ2b4;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s only been a few months since we announced the PC version, but in that time, we’ve achieved a lot of goals, the most exciting of which was releasing the Demo version of the game. We released the demo as part of the Steam Next Fest event and were overwhelmed with the amazing reactions we received from players, achieving a Very Positive user review rating. This was one of the bigger Next Fest’s in Steam's history, with over 2,700 games partaking, and we are overjoyed that we placed in the top 50 overall [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfestmostplayed_oct_2024]most-played games[/url]. 

It was amazing to personally get the chance recently to engage with some of the TMNT fan base at New York Comic Con. The passion and dedication of the fans was incredible and it’s very humbling to be able to be a part of the TMNT family. It was clear how important the franchise, its characters and stories are to so many people and I am very proud of our contribution.

The PC launch will bring support for 4K resolution, increased framerates, updated controls and many quality-of-life additions. But this is only the beginning; we will be keeping a close eye on all of the comments and feedback we receive and incorporating it into our roadmap for post launch. I’d highly recommend joining our [url=https://discord.gg/superevilmc]Discord[/url] server so you can report any issues directly to us and hopefully together we can help resolve them. 

It’s not just the PC though that is getting a release today. We have also updated the Nintendo Switch and Apple Arcade versions to include full cross-platform online matchmaking. Now, you can seamlessly find players to team up with from any platform at the tap of a button. We really believe that Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate is best enjoyed with others and now it’s easier than ever to team up and stomp some Foot!

This really is still just the start for us and there are loads of exciting updates still to come so keep an eye out for more news coming from the Super Evil Lair. We’ll be revealing both paid and free updates, including Leaderboards, New Characters, New Levels and more. We're working as hard as we physically can to bring you everything you’ve asked for! ;) 

I am incredibly proud of the wonderful work of the team at Super Evil Megacorp as we continue our journey of transforming into a multiplatform studio and I can’t wait to surprise you all with some of the content being worked on right now.

Hope you are all enjoying the game, come and join us Discord to let us know your thoughts. 


Cowabunga!
Tom

notes.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - PC release date
notes.notes:
Shellheads - it’s time for a radical update from the Lair! Gather your fellow ninjas and join the Splinter Clan in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate. We're thrilled to share a lot of exciting news with you today, with the biggest announcement being that our official PC release date on Steam, Steam Deck (verified!) and the Epic Games Store is set for November 6, 2024.

[previewyoutube=apa2MnxUz7I;full][/previewyoutube]

The TMNT: Splintered Fate Demo should give everyone plenty to sink their claws into while you wait for the full game. The team here at Super Evil Megacorp has worked incredibly hard to ensure that the Demo includes all of the great things you’d expect, including online and local co-op gameplay, deep replayability, and game progress that will be carried over into the main game so you can pick up right where you left off. This is going to be our first time participating in a Steam Next Fest, and we really hope that you enjoy the game. We’d love to hear your feedback on the demo - please do send us your reviews and feedback on the demo store page or our Discord - and we would value any wishlists, follows, and likes! 

When we started bringing the game to PC, we really wanted to ensure that the game felt great on the platform. We’ve added a lot of new functionality in our Options menu so that you can set the game up to play the way you want. This includes adding in the ability to rebind keymappings, change resolution, select a graphics or display device, and choose what control inputs you’d like to see onscreen. We’ve also made a number of gameplay and balancing changes along with further polish to many of the in-game assets.

We also wanted to bring something new to the game for all platforms, so today we can confirm that when we release the PC version we’ll also be adding Online Matchmaking–-- available on PC, Nintendo Switch, and Apple Arcade with full cross play support. You will see a new option to online play, “Find Run”, which will quickly drop you into a game with other players so you can experience 4-player co-op anytime without the fuss. You will still be able to party up with friends using Run Codes or couch co-op, of course. If you want to find people to play with, then come join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/superevilmc]Discord[/url] channel and hit up the “looking for group” channel. 

Did I mention that we’re also Steam Deck Verified?
